caption: The drawing depicts a single object: a back view of a long-sleeved, ankle-length dress with a fitted bodice and a gathered skirt. The dress is primarily off-white in color and is decorated overall with a repeating pattern of small, multicolored floral motifs in shades of red, blue, yellow, and green. The dress features a matching jacket or outer garment with a ruffled edge running along the back opening, the hem, and the sleeve cuffs. The drawing is rendered with fine lines and soft shading, primarily in light and neutral tones with the exception of the small, detailed flowers, which add spots of color. There are no visible fasteners or additional accessories illustrated. The artwork is signed "V. Berge" at the lower right. The background is plain and uncolored.
title: Dress
